title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve Board approves final rule to help ensure banks maintain strong capital positions
主要内容: The Federal Reserve Board approved a final rule to ensure banks maintain strong capital positions, enabling them to continue lending during economic downturns. The rule addresses capital requirements for larger banks and implements Basel III reforms and Dodd-Frank Act changes. It mandates higher quality and quantity of capital, including a minimum common equity tier 1 capital ratio of 4.5% and a 2.5% conservation buffer. The rule also raises the minimum tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets ratio from 4% to 6%, introduces a 4% minimum leverage ratio for all banking organizations, and adds a new supplementary leverage ratio for large, internationally active banks to account for off-balance sheet exposures. Chairman Ben Bernanke emphasized that these changes will improve resilience during financial stress, supporting the U.S. economy.
